subject: Urgent: MantleCare private cluster p99/error-rate regression — exec escalation & tuning ask
messages:
From: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@mantlecare.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudops@integrify.com
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: p99 spike + 500s from our private cluster (prod)

Jonas / Redwood team —

We started seeing a sharp p99 latency increase and intermittent 5xx errors on our private VPC deployment this morning (starting ~07:50 PST). Impact is visible across our conversational endpoints (tokenization + decode path). Attach: mantle_p99_trace-20281201.pdf with a short span-level trace from our side.

Quick facts from our monitoring:
- p50 unchanged (~60ms) but p99 jumped from ~280ms to ~1.8s
- error rate for decode requests rose from 0.2% to 6% between 07:50-08:25
- errors correlate with queued requests on node-group-a (CPU and wait blocks visible)

We have an active support window this morning. Can you confirm Redwood's observations and next steps? This is customer-facing for a go-live this week — we need remediation and an ETA.

Thanks,
Sarah Tan
Head of Platform Reliability, MantleCare
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@mantlecare.com>, cloudops@integrify.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: p99 spike + 500s from our private cluster (prod)

Sarah — thank you for the trace and the quick heads-up. We're on it. Initial read: looks like decode hot-shard + KV cache churn on the private nodes used by MantleCare.

Immediate actions from Redwood:
- Rishi (runtime) is taking a deep trace passthrough and will validate kernel selection and cache eviction patterns.
- I'll open a canary that pins a smaller sequence-length profile and reduces prefetch batch size for the affected routing policy.
- Laura (on-call infra) will check node-level IO/CPU saturation and confirm whether autoscaler flapping is involved.

Expecting initial findings in 60–90 minutes. If the regression is confirmed on our side we'll propose a short kernel override and a rolling canary.

Jonas
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Dec 2028 09:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: p99 spike + 500s from our private cluster (prod)

Folks — findings from initial runtime dive (summary):
- Root cause: a config regression in kernel selector for the 2.7B decoder path when sequence-length distribution shifts above baseline. The selector falls back to a less-efficient GEMM kernel causing CPU oversubscription and KV cache thrash.
- Repro: reproduced on a private replica using MantleCare trace (attached) — I captured a few syscall-level spikes.
- Short-term mitigation (tested locally): force kernel K-2 for decode and bump the local KV cache size by +15%. Both changes reduce p99 by ~65% in our local repro.

I attached kernel_adj_patch.diff (small override for selector heuristics) — it is low-risk but requires a rolling restart of the private runtime on each node. Proposal: canary to 10% of traffic for 30 minutes, then roll to 50% if stable.

I'll coordinate with Priyom for the rollout script and Laura for the node restarts.

- Rishi
Senior Runtime Engineer
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 2 Dec 2028 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: p99 spike + 500s from our private cluster (prod)

Planning note / Canary playbook (short):
1) Create a canary routing policy that pins MantleCare requests to runtime variant v2a (selector override) — 10% of requests, 30m window.
2) Launch canary across 2 nodes in the same AZ used by MantleCare (Integrify will isolate and coordinate maintenance window).
3) Monitor token-level latency, decode error rate, and per-node CPU/IO for 30m.
4) If stable (p99 < 600ms and error rate < 0.5%), increment to 50% and schedule rolling restart for remaining nodes during a 1-hour maintenance window.

Rollback criteria: any increase in 5xxs > 1% or p99 increases vs baseline.

I've attached a canary run log: MantleCare_CANARY_RUN_20281203.log (sanitized). I'll own the rollout script and will coordinate with Integrify for node restarts.

Priyom
SRE, Redwood Dedicated Operations
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Tan <sarah.tan@mantlecare.com>, cloudops@integrify.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2028 18:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: p99 spike + 500s from our private cluster (prod) — exec summary & ask

Sarah / MantleCare execs —

Quick executive summary and asks following our remediation work this weekend:
- What happened: a kernel selector regression under an uncommon sequence-length distribution led to a fallback path that increased CPU contention and caused KV-cache churn. This manifested as elevated p99 and a short-lived spike in 5xxs.
- What we did: validated repro, prepared a low-risk selector override patch, ran a 10% canary (30m) with v2a. Canary results: p99 dropped from ~1.8s to ~420ms; error rate reduced to 0.3%. Logs and traces linked above.
- Proposed next steps (need exec sign-off for brief maintenance):
  1) Approve rolling restart + selector override to all MantleCare runtime nodes (estimated downtime per node: ~60s, rolling).
  2) Redwood to run expanded 50% canary for 1h post-roll to confirm stability under peak traffic.
  3) Post-mortem + follow-ups: add selector unit test covering this sequence-length distribution, and increase default KV cache headroom for customers with >70% decode-heavy traffic.

We recommend the maintenance window in the next 24 hours to avoid go-live impact. Please reply with: (A) approval for the rolling maintenance, (B) any blackout times, or (C) request for Redwood exec to join a call now.

If helpful, Laura & Rishi are available now for a 20-minute call to walk the MantleCare SRE team through the canary results.

Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
